name: Italian Tofu Scramble with Potatoes, Zucchini & Cherry Tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Cut the tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich the tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium yellow potatoes
3 medium zucchini squash
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Small dice the potatoes (cut into ¼-inch cubes). Transfer to a medium saucepan and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil over high heat; reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 11 minutes. Once finished, drain the potatoes and set aside.
Peel and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic, and cook, stirring occasionally, 4-5 minutes.
Halve zucchinis lengthwise, then slice crosswise into half rounds. Add the zucchinis and spices to the pot and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp turmeric
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp basil
¾ tsp oregano

instructions.primary_message: Crumble the tofu with your fingers into the pot. Add the cooked potatoes and stir to combine. Sauté until the veggies are softened, 8-10 minutes.
Remove from the heat and stir in the grape tomatoes. Divide between plates and enjoy!
